intra_eligibility: groups with >= 2 items enter the averages; singletons are counted in the census and the quotient only
conductance: binary cut / min(binary volume of S, volume of complement); UNDEFINED_ZERO_VOLUME when the denominator is zero
quotient: one node per occupied prefix, edge iff a source edge crosses, no self-loops, unweighted
forman: 4 - deg(u) - deg(v) on every quotient edge
nulls: not used: #133 asks for the raw Spearman study
